info.description: Run folders in order. Each request has a built-in check (see Test Results). Edit Collection > Variables first.

exec: try { pm.environment.set("hrToken", pm.response.json().token); } catch (e) { console.log("could not save hrToken"); }
try { pm.environment.set("empToken", pm.response.json().token); } catch (e) { console.log("could not save empToken"); }
const find = (m) => list.find(x => [x.workEmail, x.companyEmail, x.email, x.personalEmail].includes(m));
const j = find(pm.environment.get("empEmail")), s = find("sara@company.com"), t = find("ravi@company.com");
if (j) pm.environment.set("johnId", j._id); if (s) pm.environment.set("saraId", s._id); if (t) pm.environment.set("thirdId", t._id);
pm.test("John found", function () { pm.expect(j, "john not in list").to.exist; });
pm.test("Sara found (create with E1 if missing)", function () { pm.expect(s, "sara not in list").to.exist; });
pm.test("Ravi found (create with E1 if missing)", function () { pm.expect(t, "ravi not in list").to.exist; });
